diagnosis.original_evidence: Original R30PeripheralAnchor abruptly switched from 0 to >=0.40 at the 0.40 NDC threshold; the same branch enabled both 0.90 and 0.65 peripheral boost in one draw.
source_trace: Original game OutRunHudPeripheralText glyph producer selects exact driving text without GOAL and world markers.
R30GetExactHudEdgeAnchor groups source bounds, R30ExactPeripheralHudBoost and R30AdaptivePeripheralHudBoost alter paired-eye HUD optical size.
R30TransformXyzrhwStereo uses one shared anchor offset for both eyes before the preserved OpenXR host stereo view.
diagnosis.root_cause: Hard threshold and boolean zoom opt-in created discontinuous, screen-visible text group snapping and size changes during source screen motion.
alternatives_rejected: Changing global OpenXR FOV would affect working world stereo without removing source-space HUD threshold.
Moving all ScreenHud producers would change GOAL/+TIME/F11 and bypass exact producer semantics.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Portable C++ source helper uses continuous cubic smoothstep for XY anchor and both zoom paths, keeping per-eye fitting logic; 4:3/16:9/21:9 smoke was executed locally.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Nine source/header destructive mutations, centered and invalid geometry, and cross-aspect numeric transitions accompany integrated CI.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: One exact source-space group weight is reused in both eyes; host FOV/RT, UV and protected semantics remain unchanged.

remaining: Await final Win32 exact SHA and matching Quest3/VDXR user runtime evidence. No headset PASS or FPS gain claimed.
